name: gizza-ai/csv-pivot
summary: Build a pivot table from a CSV.

tool.description: Build a pivot table: group rows by one or more `rows` columns, spread the distinct values of the `columns` field into output columns, and fill each cell by aggregating the `values` column (agg = sum/count/avg/min/max). Row keys and pivot columns are in first-seen order; empty cells are blank. Requires a header row.

data.description: The CSV text (first row must be a header).

rows.description: Row-key column(s) — comma-separated names or 1-based indices. Their distinct combinations become output rows.

columns.description: The column whose distinct values become the pivot's output columns.

values.description: The column to aggregate into each cell.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
